This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Togorian/Legends|Togorian]] and the innkeeper of the [[Soft Landings Inn]], an inn on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[43 BBY/Legends|43 BBY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] went to the Soft Landings Inn looking for the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Ona Nobis]]. The innkeeper admitted the Jedi into the inn without any trouble.<ref name="TDH" />
